domain.earlyInputs: closed own data record with profile and nativeEquipmentType only; no slots, factor, difficulty or city virtual input
domain.invalidType: signed type below 0 or above 11 returns zero; reason native-invalid-type-return-zero; downstream observations false
domain.singleItemType: signed type 5..11 returns one; reason single-item-return-one; downstream observations false
domain.slots: exactly three dense array slots; null is resolved validator failure, otherwise closed own data record {intelligenceGetterEax:uint32,skillHelperEax:uint32}; at least one non-null slot; first slot may be null
domain.getterConsumption: 00489090 result AL only via MOVZX EAX,AL; 004890F0 full EAX nonzero means skill; no skill short-circuit of remaining slots
domain.skillQueryMapping: type 0 => -1, types 1..3 => 80, type 4 => 81; type 0 still calls skill helper
domain.factorPrecondition: caller has resolved the actual 005C5F90 ST0 return and supplies its exact supported binary32 bitword; no facility level, defaults, arbitrary numeric factor or inferred stock constants
domain.cityVirtualPresence: required iff difficultyWord equals 2; otherwise property must be omitted, including null or undefined
domain.validation: closed own-data-property input; no coercion, accessors, unknown keys, symbols or sparse slots; engineering rejection is not native zero
domain.allInvalid: unsupported; native max stays INT32_MIN and base low32 is 0x800003E8 (signed -2147482648), not native early zero
domain.normalReturn: finite supported factor and normal x87/conversion return only; exception masks and original FPU runtime are not certified

arithmetic.order: skill doubling before facility multiplication; conversion toward zero before conditional super doubling
arithmetic.convertedQuantity: 3F800000 => n; 3F99999A => 6*n/5; 3FC00000 => floor(3*n/2), only for supported n=skillAdjustedQuantity
arithmetic.superApplied: difficultyWord === 2 && cityVirtualEax === 0; full EAX, not AL or an inferred AI flag
arithmetic.excludedRules: no 9000 cap, minimum 1010, politics, reputation or direct specialty multiplier; returned quantity is not actual stock writer delta

floatingPointSupport.bitwordType: uppercase eight-hex string; exactly one of the three listed bitwords
floatingPointSupport.integerSuperset: all 2241 multiples of five n from 1000 through 12200 inclusive
floatingPointSupport.claim: normal-return products in this restricted domain have the same final truncation for all listed x87 precision and rounding modes; this does not authenticate actual constant-table bytes
floatingPointSupport.conversionEvidence: 00707A74 identity uses existing P0-10 supporting evidence; no new same-version complete callee or clean-stock certification
